title: Reusable Data Procedures
purpose: Turn repeated spreadsheet and corporate-export work into explicit, testable, versioned data capabilities that can be found, composed, deployed, executed and governed.
thesis: Discovery may use heuristics and AI assistance; approved procedure execution is deterministic, deployments are explicit, and every run leaves evidence.

artifact_model.deployment: Operating binding for a pinned procedure version.
artifact_model.policy_profile: Reusable bundle of execution and governance controls.
artifact_model.rule: Procedure, deployment and run are separate because they change for different reasons.

areas.Reference: Controlled dictionaries, code lists and mappings.
areas.Evidence: Run manifests, hashes, profiles, drift, validations and output facts.
areas.Archive: Retained run packages or manifests according to policy.

rules: Do not modify Inbox sources in place.
Every run has a unique run identifier.
Temporary work is reproducible from source plus pinned contracts.
Failed or review-required runs do not silently publish to Outbox.
Secrets are referenced, not stored in procedure or deployment definitions.

pipeline.gate: Source is readable, allowed and registered with identity and hash.
File or workbook structure is understood enough to continue.
One source region has sufficient locator evidence.
Required fields and region shape are plausible.
Critical parsing and canonicalization rules satisfy policy.
Relation coverage and cardinality are acceptable.
Validation severity is within publication policy.
Output contract is satisfied and publication is atomic.
Confirmed manual fixes become rules, references, tests or proposed revisions.

design_principles: Capture intent and data logic rather than recorded UI actions.
Separate probabilistic discovery from deterministic execution.
Separate procedure logic from deployment configuration and run evidence.
Preserve raw source evidence before cleaning or transformation.
Separate raw, canonical and business-value representations.
Treat exceptions as first-class output data.
Model drift, quarantine and repair as normal lifecycle behavior.
Catalog reusable capabilities by metadata instead of folder names.
Promote repeated logic into typed versioned blocks.
Use pinned dependencies for approved execution.
Test drift and failure cases deliberately.
Scale governance and testing depth with criticality and data risk.

catalog.rule: Run history is not the catalog.

asset_types.block: Typed reusable capability with parameters, tests, owner and version.
asset_types.pattern: Recommended arrangement of blocks for a common problem.
asset_types.procedure: End-to-end business task with source and output contracts.
asset_types.pack: Curated domain bundle of procedures, blocks, references, fixtures and guidance.

rules: Approved procedures pin compatible block versions instead of resolving latest at runtime.
Prefer deterministic and side-effect-free blocks where practical.
Declare filesystem, network, reference-data and external-service side effects.
Custom code is an explicit escape hatch with tests, ownership and risk classification.

idempotency.rule: Duplicate triggers and retries must not create accidental duplicate publication.

execution_model.retry_rule: Retry temporary infrastructure failures, not deterministic business failures.
execution_model.publication_rule: Prepare outputs first and publish atomically only after blocking gates pass.

run_evidence.rule: A run record is immutable evidence.

fixture_rules: Prefer small synthetic files where possible.
Give every case a stable reusable ID.
Assert expected evidence as well as output rows.
Keep one main reason per focused fixture.
Review semantic output differences before updating golden expectations.

governance.rule: Maturity, trust, environment and policy profile are separate concepts.

excel_discovery.rule: Store locator strategy, evidence and fallbacks, not only coordinates found in one run.

layers.canonical: Stable representation for parsing, comparison and joins.
layers.business: Value changed by an approved business rule.

rules: Never treat zero as null without an explicit rule.
Do not invent precision already lost in the source.
Keep failed parse values as exceptions with raw value and rule ID.
Use symmetric normalization on both sides of joins.

classes.resolvable: Known repair may be proposed within policy.
classes.breaking: Stop because a structural or relation assumption is unsafe.
classes.business: Technical structure may match while business meaning changed.

drift.rule: Repair creates a proposed revision; it does not silently mutate an approved version.

architecture.recommended_start: Python package + CLI + JSON contracts + Git-backed catalog + synthetic test corpus.

ai_assistance.boundary: Accepted AI suggestions become explicit normal logic, test cases or proposed revisions.
